thread:
Sara: Hi — getting 403 when I try to open Project -> Deployments for project 'neptune-prod'. Started after we moved project into a new org. Error: "403 Permission denied: projects.neptune-prod.deployments.view". Anyone seen this?

Alex: Thanks @Sara. Can you confirm if you're using SSO or API key? Are you the project owner in the console?

Sara: SSO via Okta, I'm in group 'neptune-devs' mapped to role 'project-developer'. I used to be able to open it. I can still view other projects.

Alex: Ok. Can you paste the console error trace or a screenshot? Also share your user id (email) so I can check audit logs.

Sara: paste: HTTP 403 {"error":"permission_denied","details":"projects.neptune-prod.deployments.view"} My email sara@acme.com

Alex: grabbing audit logs...

infra-bot: Audit log snippet:
```
2024-11-02T14:08:12Z user:sara@acme.com action:console.open module:deployments resource:project:neptune-prod result:deny reason:role_not_bound
```

Alex: Interesting — looks like role binding missing for project after org transfer. @Miguel can you check SSO group sync for 'neptune-devs'?

Miguel: Looking. Our IDP shows group member present. But I see on our side the mapping exists to 'project-developer' role at org level; however inheritance didn't apply to this project due to a failed background job (role-propagation) on 2024-11-02. There's a retry queue blocked.

Rita: I'm oncall, pulling logs from role-sync worker. Error: "JobFailed: ParentOrgRefNotFound" for migration job id 98765. Likely when the project was moved the parent ref was temporarily inconsistent and job aborted.

Alex: Workaround: I can add a temporary direct binding of sara@acme.com to 'project-developer' on neptune-prod so she can continue. Sara ok with temp access?

Sara: yes please, thanks.

Alex: Done — can you try?

Sara: Confirmed — I can access Deployments now. :tada:

Rita: I'm re-queuing the role-propagation job and clearing the blocked retry queue. Also adding a guard so the job retries on ParentOrgRefNotFound.

Miguel: Also re-running full SSO group sync for neptune-devs across org->project bindings.

Alex: We'll leave this ticket open until next biz day to ensure binding persists. Plan: patch job to retry and add monitoring alert. ETA patch tomorrow EOD.

Sara: appreciated. Any longer-term changes?

Rita: We'll add a pre-migration check and an alert on failed propagation within 15 mins so we catch this earlier.

Alex: Closing note: if anyone sees 403 after org changes — check audit log for reason:role_not_bound and escalate to eng-oncall.

infra-bot: Incident task created: #INC-5421 assigned to eng-runtime.
